remarks:
Welcome home to 67 Elm St.!

This charming 3 bedroom and 1.5 bathroom home bodes character through it's original woodwork and hardwood floors and offers a comfortable partially open-concept floor plan that has a nice flow.  You will enter the home into an enclosed and heated front room where there are actually two separate spaces that can be used as flex space. Stepping further into the home you are greeted by a warm foyer that leads to the spacious living room, the eat-in kitchen, around to the half bath, laundry room, and out to the covered back deck.  Back inside the foyer leads you up to the second floor where you will find 3 bedrooms, a full bath, and access to the balcony from bedroom #2. A full basement offers an updated water heater (2023), a furnace, and ample space for storage or use.

Outside you will find a fully-fenced in back yard with a shed, a brand new pool, a covered back deck (2026), two concrete parking spaces in the front, and 2 apple trees that are fruit-bearing. There is space on the deck or in the back yard for entertaining or relaxing.

Seated just 1 block from Welch Field and just a couple of blocks from Main St., this home is positioned nearly in the heart of everything - and convenient to dining, shopping, antiquing, visiting the museum, enjoying the farmer's market, and so much more! Just a few miles from Lake Erie and I-90 for your day of adventures.  Within 15 minutes of Chautauqua Lake and Chautauqua Institution for trails, shopping, dining, and more! 

Check out this lovely home and say yes to this address!
